title: The Psychology of Money
subtitle: Timeless Lessons on Wealth, Greed, and Happiness

consideredAlternates.name: Special hardback edition
consideredAlternates.reasonRejected: The official page advertises bonus chapter content, so this edition changes the content contract and is not interchangeable with the original 2020 package.

whyThisEdition: The official Harriman House page exposes the 2020 chapter list and back matter clearly enough to lock the original package.
Google Books confirms the original 2020 English edition and ISBN 9780857197689.
ICPL and Richland Library independently match the chapter order, Confessions, the Postscript, and the excluded back matter.
The 2025 special hardback is a real alternate, but it adds bonus chapter content and therefore should not be used for the original contract.
